title: Your Moon sign = what you need
caption: Your Sun is who you are. Your Moon is what you need when the day goes sideways. Which one's yours?

beats.head: Your Sun is who you are. Your *Moon* is what you need.
Your Moon sign is your *inner* weather.
beats.sub: Moods, comfort, and what makes you feel safe.

beats.head: It changes signs every *two and a half* days.
beats.sub: So your birth time can decide which Moon you got.

beats.head: Fire Moons need *excitement.*
beats.sub: Aries, Leo, Sagittarius: plans, play, a little spontaneity.

beats.head: Earth Moons need *steadiness.*
beats.sub: Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn: show up when you said you would.

beats.head: Air Moons need *conversation.*
beats.sub: Gemini, Libra, Aquarius: talk it out, then give them room to think.

beats.head: Water Moons need *safety.*
beats.sub: Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces: feelings welcomed, never laughed at.

beats.head: Dating someone? *Learn* their Moon.
beats.sub: It's how they want to be cared for on hard days.

beats.head: The Align app puts your *big three* on your card.
beats.sub: So your Moon walks in before your face does.

beats.head: Go check your *Moon* sign.
beats.sub: Then tell someone what it needs.
